genome_source.note: TAIR10 genome from Ensembl Plants release 63 (gzip, 36462703 bytes). Replaces plantsmallrnagenes.science.psu.edu, whose TLS certificate failed verification on FARM (curl 60, job 39025251); verification is not disabled. SHA256 recorded into download_manifest.json on first download.

mature_mirna_source.note: Full miRBase mature.fa; SHA256 unknown at authoring time, recorded on first download. Filtered to the ath prefix by scripts/small_rna.py:mature_reference.

acceptance_plan: Resolve each run's FASTQ URL from the ENA filereport API at prepare time; verify ENA md5 and byte size before analysis.
Record genome and mature-miRNA source checksums on first download; pin them thereafter.
At least 90% of trimmed reads must be 20-24 nt (computed from the trimmed FASTQ; fastp's JSON carries no length histogram).
ShortStack loci must include both DicerCall 21 and DicerCall 24 among the cohort.
ath-miR156, ath-miR166 and ath-miR319 families must overlap at least one locus in ShortStack's Results.txt known_miRNAs column.
A repeat run on the same inputs must give an identical count matrix.
Do not treat these technical runs as independent biological replicates or qualify biological DE.
